result.Method of Attack: Phishing campaign delivering malicious Java downloader; Remote Access Trojan (RAT) functionality including command and control via email; Use of commercial obfuscators (Branchlock, Allatori) to evade detection; Downloading and executing additional malware components such as keylogger and infostealer; Exfiltration of stolen data via email; Persistence via replication to Startup folder; Execution of shell commands, file upload/download, keylogging, and credential theft
result.Impacted Systems: All platforms with Java installed; Windows systems
result.Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious JAR attachment hosted on AWS; Email-based command and control communication; PowerShell commands to download additional malware disguised as .jpg files
